content_sections.heading: About Jamia Hamdard
content_sections.text: Jamia Hamdard is a Deemed to be University at Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, declared by the Government of India, Ministry of Education, through a Gazette Notification dated 10 May 1989. The notice describes it as a research oriented organization, accredited by NAAC in the 'A+' Category. It also says the university is ranked among the top 50 Universities in India and 1st in the Pharmacy category in NIRF-2025.

content_sections.heading: Jamia Hamdard Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. Candidates also need one of the following: At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above. Eight years of service in Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor, along with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education. 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. The minimum qualification, pay and other benefits shall be as per the UGC/Statutory bodies/Jamia Hamdard norms. The official notification has the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 1000/-, paid through the online payment link or QR code in the notice. The notice writes the amount in words as "Rupees One Thousand Hundred only", which does not match the figure cleanly.

rows.event: Last date for applications to reach

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice does not set out a formal test pattern, but it refers to these stages: Short-listing of candidates. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be short-listed. Group discussion, if any, and further selection process. Interview/Selection Committee. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct or result of a group discussion, or the reasons for not being called for it or for further selection.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on Tenure/Deputation basis. The age of retirement for the post is 62 years. The post is based at Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jamia Hamdard Registrar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Pay the application fee through the online fee payment link or the QR code printed in the notice. Fill in the application in the prescribed format, and enter the online payment reference/UTR number and date. Attach the documents listed below. Superscribe the envelope: Application for the Post "REGISTRAR", & Advt. No. NT-10/2026, dated 30.10.2026. Include the Post Code, 001, as the notice also asks for it on the envelope. Send the application by speed post, registered post, courier or by hand to: Office of the Assistant Registrar, Establishment Section, Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi-110062. The application must reach this office on or before the last date. Late applications will not be considered, incomplete ones will not be entertained, and canvassing in any form will lead to outright rejection. Application in the prescribed proforma Curriculum Vitae with two references under whom the applicant has served two years and above Copy of certificates of education and experience Print out of the online fee payment receipt For deputation: ACRs/APARs for the last five years and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate

faq.question: Q1. Can I submit the Jamia Hamdard Registrar application online?
faq.answer: No. Only the fee is paid online. The application goes to the Establishment Section by speed post, registered post, courier or by hand.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply on deputation?
faq.answer: Those working in Govt./Central/State Universities or Government funded Higher Education Institutions may apply, subject to the conditions as per rules. Their application must come through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q3. I work at a university but am not seeking deputation. Do I need an NOC?
faq.answer: Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Govt. Organizations, Universities or other institutions must either apply through the proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview/Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q4. Who can I name as references in my CV?
faq.answer: The CV needs two references under whom you have served for two years or more.

faq.question: Q5. Can Jamia Hamdard consider someone who did not apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the university may consider the candidature of candidates who did not apply, if found suitable.

faq.question: Q6. Where will changes to this advertisement appear?
faq.answer: Updates, amendments and any corrigendum will be placed only on the Jamia Hamdard website, www.Jamiahamdard.ac.in.
